content: Xoossa Dunkaane Ooththanaas Imettida Imota
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Taas imota ehana mala neni Isra7eele naytas yoota; taas immanaas iza wozinay iza imma imma giin immiza asa imota ubbaa ne taas ekka.
Intte isttafe ekkana imotay haytantta; worqqa, bira, xarqimala,
salo misatiza qacina, ochcha teera misatiza qacina, xeeqa zo7o qacinanne booththa liiqo layno, deysha iske,
dharsho ite zo7o qalamen yeggi kessidayssa, abbaa giddon diza issi do7a galba, odoro mith,
xomppes wogara zayte, tiyettiza zaytessinne exaanes sawissiza qimame,
eefudeninne tira bollan diza kiiseta giddon woththiza margide geetettiza shuchchatanne hara al7o shuchchata.
«Histtidi tani istta giddon aqana mala istti taas dumma goynniza soo giigsetto.
Xoossa Dunkaanezanne iza giddon diza miishshata tani nena bessiza leemisoza mala ooththite.
Caaqo Qaala Taabota
«Istti odoro miththafe adussateththay nam7u wadhanne bagga, gomppay issi wadhanne bagga, dhoqqateththay qasse issi wadhanne bagga gidiza Taabota ooththetto.
Soo baggaanne kare baggaa walakay baynda worqqan meesha; iza yuuyi aadhdhanaas bolla bagga xanxaa worqqara yuushsha aaththa ooththa.
Taabotaas oyddu worqqa sagayota ooththada oyddu tohotan issi baggara nam7u sagayota, qasse hankko baggara nam7u sagayota aaththa.
Hessafe guye odoro miththafe tooho miththata kessada worqqa tiya.
Taabotaa tookkana mala Taabotaza millen diza sagayotan tooho miththata gelththa.
Tooho miththati Taabotaa sagayota giddon detto; istti heeppe mulekka kezopetto.
Tani nees immiza caaqo qaala markka taabotaa giddon woththa.
«Harara walakettontta worqqafe xalala nam7u wadhanne bagga aduqqiza, issi wadhanne bagga aakkiza maaroteththa kama ooththa.
Kamaza xeera nam7u baggara qoxxada nam7u kirubeta worqqafe ooththa.
Issi kirubeza issi bagga gaxan, nam7anththo kirubeza hankko bagga gaxan nam7atakka maaroteththaa kamazara gaththa ooththa.
Kirubeti ba qefe denththidi maaroteththa kamaa bollara kammetto; qasse issoy issaakko simmi uttidi kamazakko xeelletto.
Tani nees immiza caaqo qaala markka Taabotaa giddon woththa; qasse kamaza Taabotaas bolla baggara woththa.
Caaqo qaala markkay izan diza Taabotaa kamaa bolla diza nam7u kirubetappe giddon tani nenara gaaggada Isra7eele asaas immiza azazo ubbaa heen ta nees immana.
Xoossas Shiiqiza Uketh Izan Woththiza Xaraphpheeza
«Odoro miththafe adussateththay nam7u wadha, gomppay issi wadha, dhoqqateththay qasse issi wadhanne bagga gidiza issi xaraphpheeza ooththa.
Histtada walakay baynda worqqan tiya; qasse iza yuushon worqqa xanxa yuushsha aaththa.
Hessaththoka qasse aahoteththi tadhdhako gidiza xanxa iza bolla yuushsha aaththa. Histtada iza bolla worqqa balxxanth yuushsha aaththa.
Xaraphpheezazas oyddu worqqa sagayota medhdhada, xaraphpheeza tohoti diza oyddu baggara oyththa.
Xaraphpheeza tookkanaas tooho mith iza giddora aaththiza sagayoti xaraphpheezazas xanxa matan detto.
He tookkiza miththata odoro miththafe kessada, worqqa tiyada isttara xaraphpheezaza tookka.
Hessaththoka qasse saanetanne pil7ota, duuqqana xaarotanne kereta walakay baynda worqqafe ooththa.
Ta sinth aadhdhiza geeshsha ukeththay ubba wodekka xaraphpheeza bollafe dhayoppo.
Xomppe Istta Bolla Woththiza Ballata
«Worqqafe xalla qoxxada xomppe istta bolla woththiza ballata kessa; qasseka iza qoxxada xomppezi izan eqqiza toho, giddo toomanne toomaza kureta, dhemotanne ciishshata ubbaa ooththa.
Issi millera heedzdzu ballati, issi millera qasseka heedzdzu ballati issi bolla usuppun haggati izas detto.
Usuppun ballataska issaas issaas dhemoynne ciishshay izan diza ochcholoone geetettiza miththa ciish misatiza heedzdzu kureti detto.
Xomppeza giddo toomay, dhemotinne ciishshati izan diza ochcholoone geetettiza miththa ciish misatiza oyddu kureti detto.
Nam7ay nam7ay issife waaththan diza heedzdzu ballatappe garsara issi issi dhemoy de7o.
Dhemotinne ballati wuri giddo toomazappe qoxettidi walakay baynda worqqafe oosettetto.
«Hessafe guye Xomppe woththizasozas laappun eexxizaso giigsada xomppeti sinththa bagga poo7ana mala oyththa.
Xomppeza bolla eexxishe qaammida shalota kessiza qaphetanne xiixa woththiza saaneta walakay baynda worqqafe ooththa.
Xomppezinne iza miishshati wuri heedzdzu tammanne ichchashu kilo giraame gidiza walakay baynda worqqafe oosettetto.
Tani nena zumaa bolla bessida leemisoza kaallada akeekan ooththa.
